articles.summary: Personal Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents rely on interaction history to infer what a user wants from ambiguous instructions and to anticipate recurring routines. articles.summary: Most image generation models rely on uniform tokenization, allocating the exact same computational budget to equally-sized image patches. articles.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal reasoning, yet they remain prone to generating plausible but incorrect answers.
